items.title: Introducing Spend Management: Spending limits and alerts for Cloudflare
items.summary: Spend Management adds opt-in spending caps for Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects, and more products soon. Here is how we built the metering pipeline that turns usage into runtime decisions.
